explication: AIPOCH Open-Science is a local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench. The principal workflow is: a researcher defines a project task, an agent session plans and requests approvals, tools execute notebook, compute, file, and scientific-data operations, and the system publishes artifacts with provenance for review. The graph preserves documented connector, remote-compute, reproducibility, and evidence capabilities. Several orchestration links are inferred from the documented product flow and tree structure; sampled source directly confirms connector policy, filesystem artifact handling, storage-root management, and notebook network isolation.
